claims: As of April 8-9, 2026, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) was trading around $96–$98 per barrel, as reported by Trading Economics and CNBC.
As of April 8-9, 2026, Brent Crude was trading near $97 per barrel, as reported by Trading Economics and CNBC.

As of April 8-9, 2026, WTI Crude (U.S. Benchmark) was ~$97.16 per barrel.
As of April 8-9, 2026, Brent Crude (International Benchmark) was ~$97.14 per barrel.

Prices later recovered after April 8, 2026, notes The New York Times.
